purpose: Test a deployable causal allocator that prices future predicted opportunities instead of spending airtime chronologically.

causal_time.frame_generation_period: one second divided by 30 with integer nanosecond generation timestamps

congestion_state.signal: causal running mean of x_primary_phy_busy_fraction_20ms within the current run
congestion_state.regime_boundaries: training-group tertiles computed separately for each outer fold and time bin
congestion_state.training_group_state: mean signal through the end of the current five-second bin
congestion_state.evaluation_group_state: mean signal through the current decision only
congestion_state.ablation: also evaluate one global regime with otherwise identical accounting

shadow_price.score: nonnegative predicted benefit divided by exact canonical reservation
shadow_price.future_pool: all candidate rows at or after the current time-bin start from training groups in the current learned congestion regime
shadow_price.resource_curve: sort the future pool by score descending and accumulate exact canonical reservation per contributing training run
shadow_price.opportunity_cost: the marginal score at the current balance plus causally remaining refill
shadow_price.admission_rule: act exactly when current score is at least the opportunity cost, score is positive, and current spendable credit covers the reservation
shadow_price.tie_break: smaller frame_id, then stable row identity
shadow_price.remaining_budget_exceeds_curve: use zero opportunity cost and admit any positive-score action that current credit permits

evaluation.counterfactual_outcomes: known-propensity doubly robust CDF replay with cross-fitted arm nuisances
comparators: same-variant exact static per-run 372000-us predictor frontier

interpretation_limits: The shadow price is a nonparametric fractional-knapsack approximation to the finite-horizon value difference, not a perfect dynamic program.
Cross-fitted frame replay does not reproduce policy-induced contention or queue feedback.
The action-clean lag-8 population excludes startup and other generated frames, so a closed-loop campaign remains necessary.
The full-horizon carry setting isolates allocation quality; it is not a claim that unused credit alone helped V3.
